title: irxclean Workflow: From Raw Data to Cleaned Dataset
text: irxclean provides structured workflow detecting flagging potentially erroneous pharmacokinetic observations real-world clinical datasets. workflow two conceptually distinct phases: Phase 1 — Pre-model cleaning (run , fitting base model): Exclusion criteria – structured logical exclusions: subjects doses, observations infusion, dose AMT outliers, etc. Gross data quality assessment – model-independent screening concentration anomalies, covariate outliers, missing data. Phase 2 — Model-informed cleaning (requires stable base model): Iterative flagging – CWRES-based detection via NONMEM/PsN, producing ranked list potentially erroneous observations user review. Stability & metrics – tracking parameter stability across iterations. Demographic comparison – checking demographic bias flagged subjects. reviewing flagged observations, remove_observations_from_data() applies user-approved exclusions. single call generate_report() produces structured HTML summary findings.

title: irxclean: Model-Informed Detection of Potentially Erroneous Pharmacokinetic Observations — irxclean-package
text: `irxclean` provides suite tools detecting flagging potentially erroneous pharmacokinetic (PK) observations real-world clinical datasets user investigation review. assessment potentially erroneous data inherently model-dependent population PK/PD analyses, package centres iterative approach uses NONMEM (via Perl-speaks-NONMEM, PsN) re-estimate model observation removed, surfacing observations distort fitted model. ## Workflow typical `irxclean` analysis proceeds four stages: 1. **Gross cleaning** - model-independent assessment raw data quality:    covariate distribution outlier screening, detection concentration    elevations without intervening dose, missing-data summaries.    See [assess_data_quality()]. 2. **Iterative flagging** - CWRES-based iterative identification    worst-fitting observation NONMEM estimation, producing ranked    list potentially erroneous observations user review.    See [remove_erroneous_obs()]. 3. **Stability & metrics** - track parameter stability, pOFV, RMSE,    flag potential model instabilities across iterations.  See    [check_model_stability()] [plot_removal_metrics()]. 4. **Demographic comparison** - compare subjects flagged observations    full dataset screen demographic bias.    See [plot_demographic_comparison()]. reviewing flagged observations, [remove_observations_from_data()] applies user-approved exclusions produce final cleaned dataset. single [generate_report()] call produces HTML summary findings. ## NONMEM / PsN requirement [remove_erroneous_obs()] requires working PsN installation (`execute`, `sumo`) accessible system `PATH`.  functions work pre-computed results require NONMEM PsN.
